description.zh: 智能接入网关实例服务地址。取值如：**192.168.1.1**。
description.en: The service address of the Smart Access Gateway instance. Example: **192.168.1.1**.

description.zh: 智能接入网关实例服务地址类型。仅取值：**ProbeTask**。
description.en: The type of the service address for the Smart Access Gateway instance. Set the value to **ProbeTask**.

description.zh:
智能接入网关实例所属地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~69813~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The ID of the region where the Smart Access Gateway instance is deployed.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~69813~~) operation to query region IDs.
The instance ID of the Smart Access Gateway instance.

description.zh: 智能接入网关设备序列号。
description.en: The serial number of the Smart Access Gateway device.
